text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Phew, I'm so full! I'm starting to get 
sleepy."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe, we ran so much, Rice is feeling a 
little sleepy too. 
But we have to keep giving it our best!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"To think we would be provided lunch in 
the middle of an audition. 
We must thank Beauty-shi for her 
consideration."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"'There is no beauty in an unhealthy 
diet!' 
Curren likes to be careful about what she 
eats too, so I totally relate♪"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, my diamonds in the rough 
gathered in the hall! 
You will now be taking a one-hour lunch 
break!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"There is no beauty in an unhealthy diet! 
Eat up, and show me your splendid beauty 
this afternoon as well♪"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"You cannot leave the hall during lunch, 
but you're free to discuss the riddles, so 
make good use of your time!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"And as for our exciting progress—80% of 
teams have cleared the First Riddle. 
And believe it or not, some teams have 
already cleared the Second Riddle!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"So, here's an additional explanation 
regarding the 'Final Riddle'! 
Everyone who reaches the Final Riddle will 
be solving the exact same one."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"In the interest of fairness, each team 
only gets one attempt. 
The time limit to solve it is 10 minutes, 
so be mindful!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Will there be a diamond in the rough who 
solves the Final Riddle and proposes to 
their racing outfit? I'm expecting great 
things~☆"

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Some teams have already solved the second 
one... but we can't give up! 
We have to show Beauty-san that we won't 
give up until the very end!"

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! I... often get scared and can't 
perform at my best, but... 
I want to stand proud in this audition!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Is everyone... the same as 
Curren-chan...?)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(They all have a 'side of themselves' they 
want to show...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Heeey, Fine-san. 
Shall we get back to solving the riddle 
soon?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, right! 
Sorry, I spaced out for a moment."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let me read the problem once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"'In the room where all numbers gather, 
look up to find the treasure. 
The beginning of a legend: on your mark'—"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Get set, go!

text_block_list.name: Rice & Urara
text_block_list.text: "Uuu~~! Umadacchi! Uuu~~!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Umapyoi—wait, hyawaah, I'm so sorry! 
This song is just so catchy!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait, this is it! 
Rice-san, Urara-san, keep singing just 
like that♪

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Y-You want me to sing? Um— 
Uma uma umya unya 3 2 1 fight!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If we add up 3, 2, and 1... that's "6"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Could "gather all the numbers" in this 
riddle 
mean we're supposed to add up every number 
in the song?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, "Umapyoi Densetsu" has 
all sorts of numbers in the lyrics, 
doesn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! Then I'll sing the whole 
thing! 
First, second, third, fo-ur-fi-ve!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hawawa! Urara-chan, wait! 
Um, 1 plus 2 plus 3 plus 4 plus...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In the lyrics, the "four-five" part of 
"first, second, third, four-five" 
is written out in kana, so maybe we don't 
count 4 and 5?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see, so there are trick questions as 
well. 
Could the three of you please continue 
singing for us, then?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Just to be safe, Urara-san's group will 
handle the lyrics, while Curren-san and I 
do the math, and then we'll cross-check 
our results.

text_block_list.name: Curren & Ikuno
text_block_list.text: —The answer is Room 109!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, wonderful♪ 
Didn't it really feel like we put all our 
heads together just now?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because Urara-san and Rice-san sang for 
us, 
we were able to realize what the riddle 
meant—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And because Fine-san remembered the lyrics 
by the "text" rather than just the 
"sound," 
we avoided falling into the trap.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-chan's idea to cross-check was 
brilliant too! 
...Ehehe, we've become quite a great team 
before we even knew it♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
『—Alright, my rough diamonds! 
It's just about time for the afternoon 
session of the "riddle-solving" to 
begin~♪』

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm gonna run to the bathroom before 
it starts! 
I'll catch up, so go on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-Okay! ...Be careful, Urara-chan!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hurry, hurry! Gotta catch up~! 
Everyone is in... Room 109♪

text_block_list.name: Elderly Guest
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... I'm so sorry to bother you 
out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Guest
text_block_list.text:
Do you happen to know how to get to the 
annex? 
I can't seem to find my way back to my 
room.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Are you lost, Grandma? 
Don't worry, I'll take you there!
